summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser as specified. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, one parametrized test covering valid and invalid shapes (with a graph-unchanged check), and a separate test for None and plain-string inputs. The new tests and the unmodified test/test_path.py pass: 39 tests under the prepared venv. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv and no system copy exists, so formatting and the type-check (including unused type-ignore warnings) have not been run; line lengths were checked by hand and are within 88 columns. No files were committed.
